video_title: China’s Hidden Tea Paradise: Shuangfeng Village

quotes.speaker: Gordon Gu
quotes.summary_phrase: Gordon Gu on the importance of tea in his life
quotes.excerpt: Tea is a big part of my identity.
quotes.quote: This is very peaceful here. Shuangfeng Village in Hangzhou. Exploring a tea farm. Those who know I love tea, tea is a big part of my identity. So today we're going to get to explore, make some tea, drink some tea, and just have a good time and find our inner peace.

quotes.speaker: Gordon Gu
quotes.summary_phrase: Gordon Gu on his grandmother's influence and tea gardens
quotes.excerpt: It helps me feel more connected to my grandmother.
quotes.quote: My grandmother had a garden. She would grow tea. We would grow white tea. We would drink tea together, me and my grandmother. So sometimes I love to drink tea or go explore gardens like this because it helps me feel more connected to my grandmother.

quotes.speaker: Gordon Gu
quotes.summary_phrase: Gordon Gu on his dream of opening a tea shop
quotes.excerpt: I've always wanted to have a tea shop. That's like my dream.
quotes.quote: I love tea. I've always wanted to have a tea shop. That's like my dream. So I'm one step closer. When I create my tea shop, when you come to America, you better visit or else.
